uncovered_shapes.sentence: AWS provided technical support for that development environment and for its monitoring framework, according to the paper’s sources.

claims.claim: Unilever launched NOVA, a five-agent system built with Microsoft on Foundry, and in pilot markets the first stage of order-to-cash fell from 15-to-20 minutes to about 90 seconds.
claims.episode_span: Unilever cut order handling from twenty minutes to ninety seconds for retailers.
claims.source_title: Unilever’s multi-agent creating customer value at global scale
claims.supporting_quote: Across the 11 pilot markets, NOVA is reducing the first stage of the order-to-cash process from 15-to-20 minutes to around 90 seconds, says Castro.

claims.claim: Unilever processes around 20 million orders a year for about 300,000 direct customers, and about two million orders still arrive in non-standard formats.
claims.episode_span: Unilever still takes about two million orders a year in non-standard formats, out of about 20 million
claims.source_title: Unilever’s multi-agent creating customer value at global scale
claims.supporting_quote: Unilever, the global consumer goods company behind well-loved brands such as Dove, Vaseline and Domestos, processes around 20 million orders a year

claims.claim: In the pilots, orders are 95 percent touchless and eight times faster, refund claims are twice as fast, and new customer onboarding has been reduced by 90 percent.
claims.episode_span: orders in the pilots are eight times faster than before, refund claims are processed twice as fast, and new-customer onboarding has been reduced by 90 percent
claims.source_title: Unilever’s multi-agent creating customer value at global scale
claims.supporting_quote: Orders are now 95% touchless, with teams stepping in where exceptions require review, and eight times faster than before.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced the OpenShell Reference Architecture, and says Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers 30 times higher throughput per megawatt on agentic workloads.
claims.episode_span: Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are said to deliver 30 times higher throughput per megawatt on agentic workloads
claims.source_title: NVIDIA unveils architecture for secure enterprise AI agents
claims.supporting_quote: For agentic workloads, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver 30x higher throughput per megawatt.

claims.claim: NVIDIA Sentry on BlueField-4 quarantines an out-of-bounds agent in milliseconds and boosts agent capacity by up to 20 percent.
claims.episode_span: BlueField-4 runs NVIDIA Sentry, which quarantines an agent that leaves its software boundary in milliseconds and boosts agent capacity by up to 20 percent
claims.source_title: NVIDIA unveils architecture for secure enterprise AI agents
claims.supporting_quote: if an agent attempts to move outside its software boundary, NVIDIA Sentry quarantines and stops it in milliseconds.

claims.claim: ServiceNow announced general availability of Arc, with access revocable across software and hardware within seconds via OpenShell and Sentry.
claims.episode_span: ServiceNow said Arc, a personal long-running agent, is generally available
claims.source_title: NVIDIA unveils architecture for secure enterprise AI agents
claims.supporting_quote: ServiceNow today announced the general availability of ServiceNow Arc, a personal long-running AI agent

claims.claim: Mazda Canada announced on October 26, 2026 that Google Gemini is available in the all-new CX-5 with Google built-in.
claims.episode_span: Mazda Canada said on October 26 that Google Gemini is available to eligible users in the all-new CX-5
claims.source_title: Google Gemini Enhances the Connected Driving Experience in the All-New Mazda CX-5
claims.supporting_quote: Mazda Canada Inc. today announced the availability of Google Gemini within the all-new Mazda CX-5 equipped with Google built-in

claims.claim: Apple has blocked eMudhra's compromised TLS certificates since October 19, after weak keys were found on eight intermediate CA certificates, with no evidence of malicious exploitation.
claims.episode_span: Apple has been blocking eMudhra’s compromised TLS certificates since October 19
claims.source_title: Apple Addresses Web Security Threat, Working on macOS Update With Additional Fix
claims.supporting_quote: Apple said it has been blocking eMudhra's compromised TLS web certificates since October 19 in Safari, Mail, and apps that use Apple's networking and security frameworks.

claims.claim: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion over Facebook user data, and Meta plans to appeal.
claims.episode_span: A New Mexico judge on Wednesday ordered Meta to pay $25 billion over its handling of Facebook user data
claims.source_title: Meta loses $124bn in value as AI spending plans hit US tech shares
claims.supporting_quote: On Wednesday a New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25bn over its handling of Facebook user data, which Meta plans to appeal.

claims.claim: Meta's board plans to award Zuckerberg Class C shares; he owns about 13 percent of Meta, controls about 61 percent of votes, and said selling shares to pay the tax would cut voting power to 53 percent, and he pledged to stay in California eight years.
claims.episode_span: He owns about 13 percent of Meta and controls about 61 percent of its votes
claims.source_title: Meta loses $124bn in value as AI spending plans hit US tech shares
claims.supporting_quote: Zuckerberg owns about 13 per cent of Meta, which is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, and controls about 61 per cent of its votes through super-voting shares.

claims.claim: Californians vote on November 3 on a one-off 5 percent tax on assets of billionaires living in the state on January 1, 2026.
claims.episode_span: Californians vote on November 3 on the proposed one-off billionaire wealth tax
claims.source_title: Meta loses $124bn in value as AI spending plans hit US tech shares
claims.supporting_quote: Californians vote on 3 November on the tax, proposed by a health union.

claims.claim: Springer Nature and Google DeepMind are developing an AI peer-review assistant prototype inside Springer Nature's private Gemini Enterprise environment using Google's Agent Development Kit.
claims.episode_span: a prototype is in test, built with Google’s open-source Agent Development Kit
claims.source_title: Springer Nature and Google DeepMind partner on AI peer review assistant
claims.supporting_quote: The assistant is being developed using Google’s open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK) and operates entirely within Springer Nature’s private Gemini Enterprise environment.

claims.claim: Victor Yin now oversees much of Apple's display development as Wei Chen and John Zhong, each with about 30 years at Apple, become advisers.
claims.episode_span: Victor Yin now oversees much of Apple’s display development
claims.source_title: Apple Display Veterans Step Back as New Leaders Take Over
claims.supporting_quote: Victor Yin now oversees much of Apple's display development following years of preparation under Wei Chen and John Zhong.

claims.claim: Google appointed Dr. Anne Claire Grammer as Senior Clinical Specialist, Mental Health, for Gemini; she said more than a billion people use the Gemini app every month.
claims.episode_span: Google appointed Dr. Anne Claire Grammer, an adjunct clinical assistant professor at Stanford
claims.source_title: Google appoints Anne Claire Grammer to senior Gemini mental health safety role
claims.supporting_quote: With over a billion people using the Gemini app every month, there’s a real opportunity to ensure the mental health information users find is safe, evidence-based, and helpful

claims.claim: KB Financial, the first South Korean financial group to sign a corporate AWS contract in 2020, runs more than 2,000 servers and more than 100 services on AWS and was invited to AWS's Executive Briefing Center.
claims.episode_span: More than 2,000 servers and more than 100 services already run in Amazon Web Services for KB Financial Group.
claims.source_title: KB Financial Group Deepens AWS Tie-Up to Speed AI Banking Push
claims.supporting_quote: It now runs more than 2,000 servers and more than 100 services in the AWS cloud environment.

claims.claim: In July, KB worked with Google Cloud on KB Davis and KB Star Byeoli, and in July opened the KB AI Dev Center with AWS technical support.
claims.episode_span: In July, KB worked with Google Cloud on KB Davis, a Gemini-based data analytics AI, and on KB Star Byeoli
claims.source_title: KB Financial Group Deepens AWS Tie-Up to Speed AI Banking Push
claims.supporting_quote: In July, it worked with Google Cloud to develop KB Davis, a Gemini-based data analytics AI, and KB Star Byeoli, a customer consultation AI.

claims.claim: Gurman expects Apple to unveil touch OLED 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros on Wednesday, October 28, at a Los Angeles event at 10 a.m. Pacific.
claims.episode_span: Apple’s “Pro and tell” experience is set for Wednesday, October 28, at 10 a.m. Pacific Time in Los Angeles
claims.source_title: Apple Reportedly Announcing New MacBook Pro With OLED Touchscreen on Wednesday
claims.supporting_quote: Apple plans to unveil 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays on Wednesday, October 28, according to Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman.

claims.claim: Apple stores began rolling out this month a device that scans a sealed iPhone and runs diagnostics without opening the box.
claims.episode_span: Apple has begun giving retail staff a device that scans a sealed iPhone and runs diagnostics
claims.source_title: Apple Stores Reportedly Rolling Out New Anti-Theft System for iPhones
claims.supporting_quote: Apple has started providing retail employees with a device that can "scan an in-box iPhone and run diagnostics on it to make sure the phone is fully intact, leaving the box sealed and able to be put back into inventory."
